site.name: CommunityOne
site.defaultTitle: CommunityOne — Open Navigator | Civic data & policy tracking
site.defaultDescription: Follow what local governments decide: cities, counties and school districts across the U.S. Explore nonprofits and analyze meeting minutes with AI. The open path to everything local - policy tracking, advocacy, and civic engagement.
